changelog:
**Major update: Switch to AITUN/1 plain-TCP handshake for RDP routing (no TLS required).**

- Now uses plain-TCP handshake (AITUN/1, v4.9.22+) so multiple RDP tunnels share a single public port 3389, without TLS or per-user ports.
- Updated instructions to reflect the new "tcp-proxy" connection workflow for remote clients (using `aitun tcp-proxy -l`).
- Minimum required aitun version is now v4.9.22+; v4.9.23 recommended for clearer connection hints.
- Removed old TLS/SNI-based routing documentation, added details about using the plain handshake for subdomain routing.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.
summary: Expose local RDP (Remote Desktop) servers to the public internet via aitun TCP tunnel. Uses the AITUN/1 plain-TCP handshake (v4.9.22+) so multiple subdomains...
